description: Unofficial fan-art animated companion inspired by original-series Diamondhead from Ben 10. Aquamarine crystal surfaces feature gentle forearm-cluster displays, chest-facet taps, palm-crystal inspection and harmless wrist adjustments, plus a broad-legged jump and three articulated running views. The black-and-white outfit, badge and panel details are simplified creative adaptations. No attacks or projectile effects. Independently drawn; not endorsed by the rights holder.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
